relateList.title_en: Development of artificial intelligence application in oral clinical diagnosis and treatment
relateList.title_cn: 人工智能在口腔临床诊疗中的应用进展
relateList.intro_en: With the arrival of the era of big data, artificial intelligence has developed rapidly and is widely used in medical fields such as image recognition and assisted diagnosis.
relateList.intro_cn: 随着大数据时代的到来，人工智能快速发展。

relateList.title_en: Machine learning models for protein structure prediction: a review
relateList.intro_en: Recent advances in deep learning have transformed protein structure prediction, enabling near-experimental accuracy from sequence alone.
